Insomnia & Sleep Disorders

Ailment insomnia sleep nervous-system anxiety stress

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Sleep disorders characterized by difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or excessive daytime sleepiness, often related to stress and anxiety.

Symptoms

  • difficulty falling asleep
  • frequent awakenings
  • feeling unrested after sleep
  • daytime fatigue
  • irritability
  • concentration problems

Remedies for This Condition

  • Vitamin B Complex
    B-complex group of B vitamins; essential for energy metabolism, nervous system function, and stress response.
  • Magnesium
    Essential mineral involved in 300+ enzymatic reactions; supports muscle relaxation, nerve function, and energy production.
  • Lavender Oil
    Calming essential oil used for relaxation, sleep, and minor skin irritation.
  • Valerian Root
    Sedative herb that promotes deep sleep, reduces anxiety, and relaxes muscles; acts on GABA receptors in the brain.

Affected Body Systems

  • nervous
  • endocrine
  • musculoskeletal

Severity Levels

  • mild
  • moderate
  • severe
